additional_direct_fees_treatment: Excluded from scenario, not verified absent; parking/tolls/insurance unresolved.
scope_notes: The rental is a 2015 Florida contract proxy dated after the study, not an SF operator quote.
The wage is a 2016 SF occupation proxy; the benefits ratio is 2015 national occupation-group data.
Fuel price is a common March-2015 California scenario across dates; vehicle specification is a wagon proxy.
Average load, throughput, onboard capacity, setup time and service budget are scenario assumptions.
Handling is one minute per operation, two operations per relocated bicycle.
Driving labour uses each directed OSRM travel-time estimate, not an invented average speed.
No separate hourly van rent or owner maintenance is added to daily rental plus rental mileage.
The old report's 0.0087 USD/km mileage entry is corrected to 0.14/1.609344.
The old report's handling USD/hour label is corrected to USD/bike.
No mandatory end stock in base; optional sensitivity requires closing stock at least opening.
Paid-span route labour includes gaps between assigned hourly operations; overtime/shift caps are not modelled.
